A trip to Guam with Mom, all in one place 🌴
This trip to Guam was spent at the PIC GUAM resort, an all-inclusive resort where you can eat, play, and relax all in one place.
It was close to the airport, and everything from a huge water park to various activities,
including restaurants and dinner shows, was all within the resort, making it especially satisfying for families and parents.
Because I was with Mom, I had a leisurely schedule, but each day was filled with a sense of leisure and fulfillment. _:)
If you're planning a trip to Guam, check this out!
